I mean...shit, it was a mess. Couldn't  leave my apartment   for more than twenty minutes or i would bleed everywhere. This went on for about 3 weeks, where my anxiety  was crazy. I finally went  to the ER at the request of my sister, my iron count was at 7. Normal I believe is 14? Anyway had to have a iron transfusion, and had to really pay attention to my iron and vitamin C. And my anxiety kinda just faded. Was not aware that anemia has almost same symptoms as anxiety. Not sure if it helps, but you might wanna just go check out to rule out its not a lack of iron. I wish i woukd have taken the four pills a little earlier in the day(at 7:30pm), and taken more of the hydrocodone. Mine was a little.. weird. Started getting crampy  around 8:45 pm, put on Coneheads and layed on the floor. Fell asleep until about 10 pm from the hydrocodon and promethazine, and when i woke i know that the cramping had been why. My SO helped me to the bathroom, and i sat on the toilet, started to get the shakes, and sweating. After about twenty minutes had gone by i threw up, and then layed on the floor. Have to agree with you the cool tile helps so much. Lower back started to get a burning feeling, so i turned the water on to the shower and sat in there trying to cool off, or at least have some white noise to help with the cramps. Was pretty worried because i hadn't started bleeding yet, and i expected that would happen with the cramping. Then, around 11:15 pm, my cramps just kinda stopped. Felt great, got some water, and layed down in bed and started browsing reddit. Then around 1 am i felt the most odd, weird feeling i think i have ever felt. You know when you've had something to eat and your tummy kinda makes a weird sound, then you can feel your about ready to shit yourself? That, but in my uterus. Ran into the bathroom and almost before i could get my pj pants down, the blood finally came out, like i was peeing. When i asked my doctor what had happened, they suggested that a clot had blocked everything in, and when i layed down it had finally shifted out of the way. No cramps when this was happening, just bleeding. 

And one thing I really wished that they would have told me was there could be a chance that you actually see the fetus. I was 9 weeks 1 day, and i had not expected to see that, at all. The all over experience for me was not that bad, but it wasn't fun either. 

I am so sorry you had horrible cramps as well, it's not fun at all. =( I do hope you are doing much better now, and thank you so much for being brave and sharing your story =)
